summary: John's maternal 2nd great-grandfather: Guardia Lombardi-born grocer of Scranton's Bunker Hill/Dunmore Guardiese colony, father of James Petriello.
bio:
Tree: John Petriello + Marie Dibiase, parents of James (1911); John's parents Pietro Petrillo/Petriello + Grazia Di Marino. Round 1 (Geni index, via search extracts): Giovanni 'John' Petriello b. 25 Oct 1869 Guardia Lombardi, d. 25 Apr 1939 Scranton; parents Pietro Petriello and Grazia di Marino; wife Maria Antonia DiBiasi; a second, apparently duplicate Geni profile exists. Geni lists children Rocco Frank, Katie 'Chas', Joseph, Peter, James, Rocco James (b. 8 Sep 1889 Italy), Frank W. (b. Jul 1895 PA), Josephine, Gaetano 'Anthony' and Nicholas 'Primo'; most used the spelling Petrillo. Round 1 inferred first arrival c.1889-95; Round 2 voided that inference because Rocco James belongs to another family. An Ancestry index 'John Petrello 1869-1937' is probably him but conflicts on death year; FS indexes an obituary for 'Giovanni Petrillo' on 25 Apr 1939, which confirms 1939, not 1937. Round 3 read the original birth act: born 25 Oct 1869, 3 pm, registered same day, Guardia Lombardi, Nati 1869 act 110; father Pietro Petriello fu Angelo, 33, contadino; mother Grazia di Marino di Gaetano; margin repeats 'Giovanni Petriello figlio di Pietro e di Grazia di Marino'. The FS tree birth year of 1872 is wrong. 1910 census (Scranton Ward 10, ED 88, sheet 22A): John 'Petrillo', 35, at 1030 Ash Street, immigration 1880, grocery store, own account, owned house with mortgage; wife Marie 40, mother of 6 children all living; children Katie (13), Peter (12), Frank (10), Joseph (5), Tony (3), Charlie (1). 1920 census (Scranton Ward 10, ED 142, sheet 13A): John 'Patrello', 50, at 1028 [Bunker Hill], immigration 1892, naturalized 1900, merchant, grocery store, own account, owned free of mortgage; wife Mary 43; children Peter (laborer, coal company - name hard to read, 'Quinn'? Coal Co.), Frank (laborer, coal breaker), 'Chas', Ralph, Anthony, James, Michael, Rocco and Carrie. FS-tree arrival events list 1880, 1890 and 1892; the conflicting census years and age drift (35 in 1910, 50 in 1920) suggest more than one crossing. Father's occupation on James's 1931 license: 'Mdse' (merchandise). His grocery was already open by 1897, so he and Maria Antonia were among the earliest Guardiese on Bunker Hill, before the ~40 Guardiese families founded St. Rocco's Church in 1905. Son Charles was born in Pittston in 1906, so the family briefly lived in Luzerne County. Both he and his wife are listed as dead on son Anthony's 1941 marriage license. A NY 'Association of Former Citizens of Guardia Lombardi' lists Petriellos among its officers (surname context only).

The Pennsylvania state death index for 1939 lists 'Giovanni J Petrillo' of Scranton, Lackawanna County, who died on 25 April 1939, under state file number 37883 ([R4-S1]). This independently confirms the 1939 death year (against the Ancestry index's 1937) and gives the number needed to order his death certificate, which should name his parents and birthplace. Five years earlier, in August 1934, son Charles's marriage-license application had shown John and Mary both still living in Scranton, with John still in 'merchandise', i.e. running his grocery ([R4-S2]). After his death the family kept the Bunker Hill house. In the April 1940 census his sons James, Nicholas and Charles were each renting a unit at no. 1028 ([R4-S3]).

Resolved: PA death certificate (1939) → Not yet seen, but now locatable: the PA death index gives state file no. 37883, died 25 Apr 1939, Scranton, indexed as 'Giovanni J Petrillo'. The certificate can be requested from the PA State Archives (RG-11) or viewed on Ancestry's 'Pennsylvania, U.S., Death Certificates, 1906-1970'.

Round 4 searched without result: Ellis Island / Steve Morse passenger search for Giovanni Petriello/Petrillo 1880-1900: no usable unauthenticated search (not attempted beyond a check of access); FamilySearch historical record search for naturalization c.1900: blocked (401); Lackawanna County naturalization (1900): no online index found
Round 4: found his 1939 PA death-index entry (Giovanni J Petrillo, d. 25 Apr 1939, file 37883) and his son Charles's 1934 marriage license showing him alive in 1934.
